Warm nonjudgmental feeling: this is someone enjoying their own way of watching, never stressed, zombified, guilty or being rescued.

Two small vertical video cards float very close above the phone, suggesting a short scroll, with simple landscape imagery and one tiny play triangle. A single subtle curved gesture swoosh reinforces the upward swipe. No gigantic phone, no UI dashboard, no addiction metaphor. Show the whole adult and cushion, legs relaxed and believable hands.
